_comment: Command case template (Docs/TextAuthoring/Plan_CommandCases.md). Read by Assets/Editor/TextAuthoring/TA_CaseTemplate.cs at every extraction; edit freely (by hand or by an agent), then Update store. Every rule here mirrors an engine fact (plan §3, §7) - keep it that way. Cases a command can't reach are pruned from its own data (requirement flags, D20, timeScale, comTags).
_comment_states: Kojo-side states a speaker or listener can be in besides awake. sides: which roles can be in it. reachableIf: fields of that side's CharaRequirement (req_Doers / req_Receivers) that must have these values. canAct: Character_Trainable.canAct in that state (false = kojo needs requireSelfAction / requireTargetAction false). tags: the character's tags in that state (what kojo selfTags / targetTags see). refuses: whether a receiver in that state can refuse (EVP_Modifiers: time-stopped, climaxing, unconscious, restrained always accept).
_comment_narrationStates: Narration-side states: narration conditions can only compare stats (COM_Descriptions Validator_Chara → Character_Trainable.CompareStatValue). condition = the validateChara a new entry for this state uses (target is filled in: doer / receiver). A stat the engine can't compare is reported as a template warning.
_comment_narration: Narration cases (completion task). field = description_<field>. when: command facts that must hold (pair, solo, ongoing, sex, d20, joinable, strong, group, itemExec). onlyIfPresent: the case exists only for a command that already has text in the field. perSide: one case per side that can climax, with condition (target filled in). states: also one optional case per reachable narration state of the receiver (pair) / doer (solo). package: a validatePackage condition (who ordered the act) the covering entry's path must have; entries with any master condition never cover a generic case. abort: description_remove, printed when the act is replaced or stopped (not while the doer is time-stopped), engine default ep_Description_abort. required: false = optional.

narration.label: 结束旁白（成功后）
narration._comment: user 2026-11-18: a command without after narration doesn't get one (no case, no new-entry slot); one that has it is reviewed

narration.label: 中止旁白（被替换或停止）
第三方下令时的开始旁白

_comment_kojo: Kojo cases (kojo task). suffix: lookup key = <command kojo key><suffix>. speakers: pair roles doer / receiver, solo role self. outcomes: accept / refuse (refuse only where the receiver can refuse). d20: an accepted result splits into Success / Failure when the command has a D20 check. states: the speaker's and the listener's reachable states each make a case. requireState / selfTags: woken = the receiver was asleep and woke (justWokenUp). fallback: a plain key that also covers the case (generic Interrupt). seen: MapUtility.CheckReverseInterrupt fetches <COM>_Interrupt for anyone walked in on, solo actors included (speaker self). joinReact: EvaluationPackage.LogMessage_Join - the act's doer and receiver (solo: the actor) react to the joiner (listener newcomer), with the action package; not while the doer is time-stopped. tiers: the relationship tier template inserted into each accepted case (tiers.json). order: ordered = a third party (the player in sex mode, the command panel's master) ordered the act - kojo sees masterRef = Package.Master, else the doer (KojoCollector.LoadEP), so an ordered doer / solo self is not the master and its branch needs requireSelfNotMaster; the receiver has no flag that tells an ordered act apart. outcome refuseOrder: the ordered doer refuses the order and speaks to the master (EvaluationPackage.LogMessage_Kojo); a doer acting on its own says nothing when it declines. First experience is not a command case (user, 2026-11-16: no position dependency) - it is the per-part OnFirstExperience_<class> kojo.

_comment_kojoContext: Writer context only. Apply kojoContext in order, then phase.context in order. match supports speaker, listener, outcome, suffix and ordered; omitted fields match any case. who merges self, target, doer, receiver and situation; null removes a field. This does not change runtime conditions.

who.doer: 施方（玩家或另一名 NPC）

_comment_profiles: Command authoring profiles share the phase definitions above. A command uses its binding, then its category parent's binding, then standard. omit excludes phases from both cases and scenes. category marks phases owned by the category unit when there is one. assign includes all eligible roles in that phase, with dedicated text at the assigned key.
_comment_roles: Whether a speaker role's kojo cases are required (D43: the reacting side must speak, the doer may).
_comment_words: How the docs name a kojo case's listener, outcome and the ordered prefix (speaker names: roles.label, state names: states.label).
_comment_overrides: Per command ID or comTag: { "drop": [case id prefixes], "optional": [case id prefixes], "require": [case id prefixes] }. Case ids look like kojo.result.receiver.awake.player.success or narr.begin.
